rows.grounds: compound sva-dakṣiṇa-grahīta; describes object held in own right hand
compound dakṣa-hasta-prasanna-dhī; describes serene disposition associated with right hand

items.question: What alternative configurations characterize the deity's right hand in this depiction?
premises: The deity may hold an object in his own right hand.
Alternatively the deity may be characterized by a serene disposition in the right hand.
The particle vā marks these as alternative configurations.
items.inference: The verse specifies two alternative states for the deity's right hand.
uncertainties: The exact object or gesture implied by svadakṣiṇagrahīto is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Either grasped in his own right hand, or with a serene disposition in the right hand.
